title: ObjectZoneListQuery
description: zone.object-zone-list-query@1 (PLANNED; ADR-031 amendment 2026-10-02): the query string of GET /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/zones on OpenVibe.Zone (capability zone.zone.list). Without env it lists both environments the caller's grant reaches. A sandbox-only grant never lists production zones.

include_deleted.description: Also list zones in state deleted. Default false.

limit.description: Items per page, 1 to 200. A query string carries it as a string, which must name the same range.
